=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:262-271 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The redirect parser removes a numeric positional argument as a file descriptor even when whitespace separates it from the redirect operator.
  WHY: A push such as `git push origin 2 > out.txt` can be parsed without refspec `2`, causing the guard to check the current branch instead of the destination and miss a merged destination branch.

- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:267-270 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The redirect parser can leave the `1` in `2>&1` as a trailing positional argument.
  WHY: `_push_targets` may treat `1` as a refspec; the reviewer reports that the fallback is conservative and can over-block rather than miss a protected destination.

- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:1541-1547 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash]
  PROBLEM: In read-only mode, an unapproved compound command containing only read-classified `gh api` calls falls through with no decision.
  WHY: In `dontAsk` mode, a command with an allowlisted prefix such as `git diff` or `git status` may run without explicit hook approval; z-ai_glm-5_2 disagrees, concluding the allowlist blocks the compound command.

- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:351-360 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The `+=` environment assignment path stores only the appended suffix in `environment["GIT_DIR"]` instead of the shell-computed value.
  WHY: minimax_minimax-m3 reports that git resolution can fail and the ancestry check can fall back to the session checkout rather than the operated-on repository; z-ai_glm-5_2 considers the uncertain-state fallback conservative and the malformed value non-impacting.

- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:1479-1485, 1517-1521 | severity=high | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: In read-only mode, the `cwd` early return can bypass the non-read denial when the payload has a missing, empty, or invalid working directory.
  WHY: The hook returns no decision before reaching the read-only non-reads check, potentially allowing a `gh api` write under `dontAsk`.

- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:1566-1571 | severity=high | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Unknown hook arguments cause `gh_api_write_guard.py` to deny `gh api` calls without clearly identifying a configuration mismatch.
  WHY: An added argument such as `--debug` can disable GitHub API reads; deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro rates this NIT, while minimax_minimax-m3 rates it MAJOR.

- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:259-643 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: Changes to `pr_merge_status_guard.py` are described as uncommitted and absent from the PR’s changed files, despite being unrelated to issue #6216.
  WHY: The changes may not ship with the PR and include out-of-scope shell-parsing and push-handling work that reviewers say should be reviewed separately.

- changelog.d/6216-claude-read-role-api-writes.md:1-2 | severity=low | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The changelog fragment lacks the required lead paragraph and audience closing described in CLAUDE.md §20.D.
  WHY: The fragment contains only a brief bullet, so it does not meet the documented changelog-entry structure.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Give read-role model processes a read-only GitHub identity and a GET-only API wrapper; deny all API writes in their hook policy."
  expected_change_site: scripts/ai_engine.sh::claude_run credential setup and the read-profile `gh api` access path through scripts/claude_engine.py and .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py::evaluate
  confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  EVIDENCE: scripts/ai_engine.sh:275-283; README (line 1991-1993); scripts/ai_engine.sh unsets all GitHub tokens via credential_prefix; README.md:1989-1993; scripts/ai_engine.sh unsets the GitHub credential variables for read-profile processes but supplies no replacement read-only identity; scripts/ai_engine.sh unsets all GitHub token variables (GH_TOKEN, GITHUB_TOKEN, GH_PAT, etc.) but supplies no read-only identity or token; The hook’s API-write denial is implemented, but the read-only identity and GET-only wrapper deliverables are absent; The README states the hook permits "GET/HEAD or read-only GraphQL queries," which exceeds the GET-only restriction specified in the issue; the hook classifies GraphQL queries as reads without restricting their HTTP method.

- requirement: CLAUDE.md §20.D requires changelog entries to include a 3-5 sentence lead paragraph and an audience closing ("What this means for <audience>:").
  expected_change_site: changelog.d/6216-claude-read-role-api-writes.md
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_2]
  EVIDENCE: The fragment is a single bullet with no lead paragraph, no numbers table, and no audience closing.

=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:1541-1547 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: In read-only mode, an unapproved compound command containing read-classified `gh api` calls falls through with no decision.
  WHY: In `dontAsk` mode, an allowlisted prefix such as `Bash(git diff*)` can permit the compound command.
- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:1535-1540 | severity=low | confidence=[2]
  PROBLEM: The writes check returns `DECISION_ASK` rather than using `_read_only_result()`.
  WHY: The earlier non-reads check makes this path unreachable in read-only mode today, but a future refactor could expose it.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:267-270 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: The redirect parser removes a preceding numeric token as a file descriptor without checking whether it is adjacent to the redirect operator.
  WHY: `git push origin 2 >&1` can lose refspec `2`, causing the guard to check the current branch instead of the push destination.
- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:1566-1568 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  PROBLEM: An unrecognized hook argument causes the guard to deny `gh api` calls without making the configuration mismatch clear.
  WHY: Adding a flag such as `--debug` can deny routine reads, while the operator may not understand why.
- changelog.d/6216-claude-read-role-api-writes.md:1-2 | severity=low | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The fragment is a single bullet and omits the lead paragraph and audience closing required by CLAUDE.md §20.D.
  WHY: It violates the documented changelog-entry structure contract.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "Give read-role model processes a read-only GitHub identity and a GET-only API wrapper; deny all API writes in their hook policy."
  Expected change site: scripts/ai_engine.sh::claude_run credential setup; scripts/claude_engine.py READ_PROFILE_ALLOW or render_settings
  Evidence of absence: The implementation strips all GitHub credentials from read-profile children (scripts/ai_engine.sh:275-283) rather than supplying a read-only identity. For public repositories, unauthenticated reads work; for private repositories where orchestrator reads need authentication, no read-only token or identity exists. The README (line 1991-1993) additionally permits HEAD and read-only GraphQL queries beyond GET. The hook denies writes but the README text contradicts a true GET-only policy.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_8-flash ===
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:268-270 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The redirect parser removes any preceding numeric token without verifying that it is adjacent to the redirection operator.
  WHY: `git push origin 2 > out.txt` loses positional refspec `2`; `_push_targets` then checks the current branch and can miss a merged destination branch.
- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:1541-1547 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: In read-only mode, an unapproved compound command containing `gh api` reads falls through with no hook decision.
  WHY: An allowlisted prefix such as `Bash(git status*)` can permit the command without explicit hook approval.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:262-271 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The parser can leave `1` from `2>&1` as a trailing positional argument.
  WHY: `_push_targets` may treat it as an additional refspec; resolution can fail and fall back to checking HEAD, incorrectly blocking the push.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: Give read-role model processes a read-only GitHub identity and a GET-only API wrapper; deny all API writes in their hook policy.
  Expected change site: scripts/ai_engine.sh::claude_run credential handling and the read-profile `gh api` access path.
  Evidence of absence: The implementation in scripts/ai_engine.sh unsets all GitHub tokens via credential_prefix (env -u GH_TOKEN -u GITHUB_TOKEN -u GH_PAT...), providing no read-only GitHub identity, and does not provide a GET-only API wrapper. As a result, in private repositories, permitted read operations such as gh issue view, gh pr view, gh pr diff, and permitted gh api reads run with no credentials and fail with authentication errors.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
